title: Django 4.2 LTS reaches end of life
summary: Django 4.2 LTS received its last security release in April 2026. Deployments pinned to 4.2.x no longer receive fixes; 5.x lines remain supported. Upgrade 4.2 deployments to a supported release.

evidences.excerpt: Django 4.2 LTS is no longer supported; only currently maintained releases receive security updates.
Django 4.2 cycle ended 2026-04-30; 5.x cycles remain maintained.
